articles.title: Bullish backs USD.AI with $100 million in financing to drive GPU-backed loans
articles.snippet: Cryptocurrency platform Bullish is extending a $100 million debt facility to USD.AI to finance GPU-backed loans for artificial intelligence infrastructure.
